slides.title: Safe at home, on your own
slides.sub: Not paranoid. Just prepared. Four small routines from our living-alone safety checklist.

slides.title: The 30-second door routine
slides.body: Lock it the moment you walk in. Keys in the same spot every time. One slow sweep before you leave: door, windows, appliances.

slides.title: Make your address known
slides.body: Emergency contacts as one-tap favorites. Your full address and building code written where you can find it fast.

slides.title: Check in with someone daily
slides.body: Agree on a loose window with one person, like a text by 9pm. Tell them when you travel and when you're back.

slides.text: Not the locks, but the quiet agreement that *someone* is paying attention to your normal.

slides.title: Read the full checklist.
slides.body: Six routines, including a plan for your first night alone. It's on the blog at singles-life.app
